title: Hardware Interface Software Engineer
description:
Amazon RIVR is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR develops wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments. Following acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we're building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery.

**The Role:**
As a Hardware Interface Software Engineer, you will be the vital link between high-level autonomy stack and physical hardware. Your mission is to build robust, low-latency software bridges that translate AI-driven intent into physical action.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Design and implement software interfaces decoupling high-level autonomy from specific hardware implementations
- Write and maintain high-performance drivers for sensors and actuators
- Implement and optimize communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet, SPI) for minimal latency and maximum reliability
- Perform system identification of actuator characteristics and optimize control loops
- Conduct lab testing and debugging at software-hardware boundary
- Develop software-level safety monitors and emergency-stop logic
- Improve Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing pipelines
- Create and maintain documentation and best practices

**Requirements:**
- Bachelor's degree or higher in Robotics, Control, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field
- Minimum 3 years industry experience (or PhD equivalent) in software-hardware interface
- Experience deploying and testing software on hardware platforms
- Modern C++ for production-level, performance-critical systems
- Python for rapid algorithm development and data analysis
- ROS/ROS2 (Robot Operating System) expertise as robotics middleware
- Strong Linux understanding (system configuration, kernel drivers, network stack)
- Good understanding of control theory for robotic actuators
- Familiarity with embedded components and hardware datasheets

**Bonus Points:**
- PhD or Master's in Robotic Control, Real-Time Systems, or Mechatronics
- Experience with legged or hybrid wheel-legged systems
- Hardware interface frameworks in ROS2 (ros2_control)
- Functional safety standards for autonomous vehicles or industrial robots

**What We Offer:**
- Work on cutting-edge robotics and Physical AI
- Collaborate with talented team on real-world delivery robots
- On-site presence required in Zurich office
